misconceptions.description: Assembling a capstone as a stack of separate artifacts with no traced decision connecting them
misconceptions.trigger: candidate pastes chapter artifacts in order without connecting the reasoning
misconceptions.feedback: Trace one decision across the chapter's tools and evidence so the portfolio shows synthesis, not a stack.

misconceptions.description: Writing the portfolio as if the reader already knows the placement context
misconceptions.trigger: candidate omits the constraint, decision, or evidence an outside reader would need
misconceptions.feedback: Make the constraint, decision, evidence, and adaptation explicit for a reader who was not in your placement.

misconceptions.description: Accepting an AI narrative that smooths over the real equity tension the candidate navigated
misconceptions.trigger: candidate submits a frictionless AI story that hides the tradeoff she made
misconceptions.feedback: Restore the tension and the hard tradeoff. The studio shows real judgment, not a frictionless story.

misconceptions.description: Treating one successful lesson as proof of transferable professional judgment
misconceptions.trigger: candidate offers a single outcome, grade, or satisfaction note as evidence of transfer
misconceptions.feedback: Show the decision rule holding across at least two situations and how you would adapt it under a new constraint.
